what: noisy SKQD campaign: one row per (lattice, family, device, sector); noisy plan point (B_all) and the ideal (noiseless) samples of the same size side by side

columns.acceptance: accepted / shots, all circuits of the sector
columns.f_hit: reference hits / sum(shots x p_ref), all circuits of the sector (k1: k = 1 only)
columns.E_R_minus_E0: Ritz energy on B_all minus exact E0 (plan point)
columns.width: certificate width (Kato-Temple with the exact E1 at B=0, Weinstein 2 r_H at B=1)
columns.E0_inside: exact E0 inside the certificate interval
columns.ideal_*: the same quantities on ideal samples with the same per-circuit shot counts
